case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4648 OF 2022 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO.18886 OF 2019)
summary: Appeal challenging inadequacy of compensation awarded for 100% permanent disability due to a 1996 road accident. Claimant, injured at age five and a half, suffered severe injuries including spinal cord damage, cerebral edema, and paralysis, requiring lifelong care. MACT awarded Rs.9,00,000; High Court enhanced it to Rs.23,20,000. Appellant sought further enhancement on grounds of lifelong loss of earnings, attendant care, medical expenses, and non-pecuniary damages. Court considered medical evidence, principles of just and reasonable compensation, and precedents. Dismissed appeal, upholding High Court's award as just and reasonable.
